{"front": "Pragmatic", "back": "Dealing with things sensibly and realistically"},
{"front": "Eloquent", "back": "Fluent, persuasive, and expressive in speech or writing"},
{"front": "Tenacious", "back": "Holding firmly to a purpose; persistent"},
{"front": "Lucid", "back": "Expressed clearly; easy to understand"}

The deck is ten flip cards, each with a word on the front and its meaning on the back. The progress bar is bound to `/progress` (0–100) and starts at 0%. The catalog's flashcard deck doesn't emit a flip event, so nothing in this markup increments that value automatically. Updating it needs a surface update that sets `/progress`, or a catalog event if one is available.
